description: Claude's memo flow, as Claude Code runs it: one Bash call that sets W to a work folder, writes the memo's text there through a heredoc, then `cd "<matter>" && pandoc "$W/reply.md" -o "Reply to Kestrel legal notice - draft.docx" && rm … && python3 …`. No location names the reply. While the client holds the call's ask, the test writes the reply; the host reads the write from the command, its cd after the assignment and the heredoc setting the folder, so the change is not flagged

rawInput.command:
W="/data/run/r1/work"
cat > "$W/reply.md" <<'EOF'
# Reply to the notice
EOF
cd "{{cwd}}" && pandoc "$W/reply.md" -o "Reply to Kestrel legal notice - draft.docx" && rm "$W/reply.md" && python3 -I -c "print(1)"

note: The test writes the reply while this ask waits, then allows it.
